responsible_authority.value: Helen Robertson (institutional guidance); Steven James and Benjamin Rosman (project supervisors / annotators)

pseudonymisation_policy.value: Stable role pseudonyms in repository artefacts; identity mapping stored separately under access control.

identity_mapping_store.value: Held by researcher outside the public repository; role pseudonyms only in tracked artefacts.

storage_location.value: Project repository governance artefacts; annotation packages under data/annotations when created.

access_controls.value: Repository access limited to project collaborators; no external annotator accounts.

retention_period.value: Retain for the duration of the Honours project and any required institutional retention period.

deletion_policy.value: Deletion only via recorded governance decision; identity mapping deleted when no longer required.

withdrawal_handling.value: Not applicable: no external participants; supervisors may withdraw by recorded role change and scope reassessment.

conflict_of_interest.value: Supervisors are annotators; role overlap must be disclosed per record in the role-overlap log.

model_label_exposure_policy: Annotators must not be exposed to model-proposed gold labels, critiques, or other annotator responses.

publication_and_release_use.value: Annotation outputs may be used for the Honours dissertation and related research reporting under project governance; no external annotator data is collected under this determination.

human_semantic_meta_evaluation.value: If performed, limited to the named project supervisors under the same supervisor-only scope and external-annotator guard.

collection_permitted_semantics: Ethics/governance gate permits annotation only by the named project supervisors under the recorded supervisor-only scope. Does not imply T13/T14 technical readiness, handbook completion, sampling freeze, or permission for external annotators.
